parts.label: Outer panel with screw holes, top (A1)
Outer panel with screw holes, bottom (A2)
Outer panel with dowel holes, side (B1, B2)

hardware.label: Short screw for the angle bracket

tools.label: Soft surface to work on (rug or blanket)
Drill for the wall holes (not shown in the manual)

steps.text: Lay the top and a side on their back edges on a rug. Join them with two long screws and the Allen key.
tools: Soft surface to work on (rug or blanket)

steps.text: Tap two dowels into the middle of the top's inner face and push a short inner panel onto them.
Tap two dowels into the middle of the side and slide the long inner panel onto them.
Tap two dowels into the middle of the long panel's free face.
Push the second short inner panel onto these dowels.
Tap two dowels into the free end of the long panel and two into the free end of the short panel.
Push the second side onto the two dowels of the long panel.
Put the bottom panel on, onto the dowels of the short panel.

steps.title: Fix the corners with long screws
steps.text: Fix both bottom corners with four long screws through the bottom panel and the Allen key.
Fix the last corner with two long screws through the top into the second side.
Screw an angle bracket to the inside of each side, at the back just under the top, with two screws each.

steps.title: Mark the wall
steps.text: Hold the unit against the wall at the height you want and mark the wall through each bracket hole with a pencil.
steps.warning: Lift the unit with two people. The wall and the screws must carry its full weight.

steps.title: Drive the wall screws
steps.text: Take the unit down and drive a round-head screw into each mark, leaving the head out.
steps.note: Wall screws and plugs are not included. Use round-head screws that suit your wall.
tools: Drill for the wall holes (not shown in the manual)

steps.title: Hang the unit on the wall
steps.text: Hang the unit on the screws, put a keyhole plate on each bracket over the screw head, tighten the screw and push on the cover.
